every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use the exact same camera choreography across frames 1 to 9, including the identical text-card overlap on the anchor rack in frame 5 and transition frames without text in frames 4 and 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites depict the exact same 3D factory metaphor—from the token flood in frame 3 to the digest press in frame 5 and host lanes in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: The second site's lighter slate floor and atmospheric horizon fog across frames 1 to 9 make cast shadows clearly visible and ground the dark navy machinery much better than the near-black floor in site 1.

type_and_layout.reason: While the typography and card layout are identical across frames 1 to 9, site 2's lighter 3D floor creates better figure-ground separation for the dark UI cards.

overall.reason: Although both sites share the same 3D models, camera path, and UI layout, the second site's lighter ground plane and visible cast shadows give the 3D scene far better depth, grounding, and separation from the dark machinery and text cards.
